highlights.title: Databricks adoption.
highlights.description: Led the design and implementation of Databricks on a 4.7 PB data platform. Moved company-wide analytics to Databricks while keeping existing batch jobs running, and migrated data and selected batch jobs in phases.

highlights.title: Company-wide Airflow platform.
highlights.description: Built a Kubernetes-based Airflow platform for all internal data platform users. Improved security and governance with authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA).

highlights.title: Data pipeline workload standardization.
highlights.description: Unified Spark job submission across EMR and Databricks and migrated selected batch workloads. Added lineage for EMR Spark jobs and laid the groundwork for standardized resource configuration and AI automation.

highlights.title: Pipeline cost optimization.
highlights.description: Established per-application cost monitoring and optimized high-cost applications while preserving business logic.

highlights.title: Data processing environment for partners.
highlights.description: Coordinated technical requirements with partners to meet data business needs. Provided secure access to the internal platform and resolved compatibility issues between build and runtime environments.

highlights.title: Web crawler development and operations for Daum and Kakao Search.
highlights.description: Designed and built a sitemap crawler and operated an app store crawler. Set up a 33-node on-premises Hadoop, HBase, and Spark cluster and migrated the crawling infrastructure. Converted MapReduce jobs to Spark.

highlights.title: Knowledge graph platform prototype.
highlights.description: Evaluated the use of a graph database and performed graph data modeling and ETL for document data.
Built a Python and Flask web tool to load file-based data into a relational database.
Automated IoT data extraction and loading, and developed web APIs.

presentations.label: The Real Challenges After TMAP Adopted Databricks
